investigator.method: One bounded, unauthenticated GET of the discovery-supplied official_website, plus one additional bounded GET of a same-origin 'Club nights' link directly exposed in that page's own navigation (curl, descriptive User-Agent, redirects followed, no retries, no browser, no auth).

identity.notes: Retrieved homepage content brands itself 'Roller Nation' throughout and describes 'the Tottenham based venue' — consistent with the candidate's given address (Bruce Grove 117, N17 6UR — Tottenham). Site navigation also resolves to sibling domains rollernation.com / rollerdisco.com under the same operator/brand.

probe_history.reason: The homepage and the same-origin 'Club nights' page it directly links to together gave a complete, current, real picture of named recurring events with days, times, and prices — sufficient to reach an honest field assessment and decision without escalating.

site_classification.platform: Squarespace (class names such as 'Header-nav-item' / 'Mobile-overlay-nav-item' observed in markup)

title.notes: Named recurring club nights are stated directly on the club-nights page (e.g. 'Own Skate Mondays', 'Soul Skate Thursday', 'Link Up Friday').

start_date.notes: The page states a weekly recurrence pattern ('Every Thursday', 'Every Friday') and a time, not a specific calendar date for each occurrence — no per-occurrence dated instance was exposed by this bounded static probe.

time.notes: Soul Skate Thursday states 'Time: 7pm – 11pm, last admission 9.30pm' directly on the club-nights page.

end.notes: Same source line gives the session end time (11pm) directly.

venue_location.notes: Homepage copy states 'the Tottenham based venue', consistent with the candidate's given address, but the full street address was not restated verbatim on the pages retrieved in this bounded probe.

source_record_id.notes: No stable per-event identifier is exposed; recurring club nights are named (e.g. 'Soul Skate Thursday') but not given individual per-occurrence IDs in this bounded probe.

event_url.notes: This is the venue's own first-party programme/booking page for its club nights; individual per-night permalinks were not confirmed within this bounded probe.

price.notes: Soul Skate Thursday states 'Price: £13.50' directly; other named nights show their own distinct prices (e.g. Link Up Friday '£17').

blockers.description: Events are recurring/weekly rather than individually dated on this page — a future collector/offline-proof package would need to confirm how (or whether) specific calendar occurrences are exposed before activation.

reasons: The retained club-nights page shows genuine, current, named recurring DJ/dance-music nights — e.g. 'Soul Skate Thursday' (soul/funk DJ sets) and 'Link Up Friday' (Hip Hop/R&B/Dancehall/Afrobeats/Amapiano DJ sets) — with real times and prices, which is electronic/DJ-club-night programming under BeatMapped's venue-level music gate.

Although branded around roller skating, the venue's own copy frames its current offering explicitly as clubbing to DJ sets ('Roller Disco is ideal for a unique night out clubbing with friends to funky and classic tunes by some of London's best DJ's'), not as a non-music activity with incidental background music.

A first-party static page (club-nights) exists as a plausible acquisition path; a dedicated offline-proof/collector-design package should confirm how per-occurrence dates are exposed before any activation.

evidence.description: Literal, contiguous excerpt of the real HTTP response body from the official homepage, describing the roller disco/club-night offering and the Tottenham location.
evidence.method: curl; descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; bounded response; single request, no retry
